summary.text: Tammy Simmons Garthwaite is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Carroll 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election; she defeated incumbent Brian R. Taylor in the September 8 Republican primary, finishing first among three candidates.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Simmons Garthwaite as the Republican candidate in Hillsborough 17 in 2018 and 2020 and in Hillsborough 19 in 2022, and she did not win in any of those general elections.
